stories.title: Trump says U.S. has struck a deal for control of Venezuelan oil reserves
stories.summary: President Trump says a new deal with Venezuela would give the U.S. control of more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves.

stories.title: Rescuers race to find thousands missing after deadly Himalayan floods
stories.summary: Rescue crews are struggling through blocked roads, high mountain canyons and dangerous terrain as they search for thousands of people missing in Nepal and Tibet.

stories.title: ICE arrests are surging as the administration targets more immigrants
stories.summary: ICE made nearly 50,000 arrests in July -- the highest monthly total of Trump's second term -- as enforcement expands to more places like airports, courthouses and immigration check-ins.

stories.title: Who gets to be Mary Todd Lincoln next? There's a list
stories.summary: Oh, Mary! has discovered an unusual way to keep a Broadway hit fresh: keep replacing Mary Todd Lincoln with someone completely different.

stories.title: What years covering Puerto Rico reveal about why the taps keep running dry
stories.summary: Puerto Rico's drought is only part of the reason residents are losing water. NPR's Adrian Florido explains what years of reporting on the island have taught him.

stories.title: What to know about FAA moves to fire two controllers after deadly LaGuardia crash
stories.summary: The FAA's response to a deadly crash is opening a larger debate about staffing, safety and a workplace practice controllers call the "early shove."
